Senna can attack souls that spawn from dead enemies to absorb their Mist. She can also siphon Mist from enemy champions she hits with Attacks or Abilities twice, dealing an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=1, perLevel=1, changes=[{"mLevel": 11, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])]% current Health physical damage.

Each stack of Mist grants [0.75] Attack Damage. Every [20] stacks grant [20] Attack Range and [10]% Critical Strike Chance but she only has [(1) × Stat(9)] Critical Strike Damage. [35]% of excess Critical Strike Chance is converted into Lifesteal.

Senna's Attacks take extra time to fire, deal an additional [(0.2) × AD] physical damage, and briefly grant her [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.1, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] of the target's Move Speed.
